title: urceolina × butcheri
intro: Urceolina × butcheri, commonly known as the Urcella orchid, is a hybrid orchid plant that combines the characteristics of Urceolina and Butcheria species. This plant has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help in the treatment of wounds, infections, and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Urceolina × butcheri are attributed to its ability to stimulate collagen synthesis, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
